mapper.sql: id, order_id, content, attachments, status, created_by, create_time
mapper.select: select from jiedan_bug where order_id = #{orderId} order by id asc

select b.order_id as orderId, b.id, left(substring_index(b.content, char(10), 1), 160) as title, b.status, date_format(b.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') as submittedAt, b.attachments as rawAttachments, r.update_id as reviewId, date_format(invite.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') as reviewTime, u.id as replyId, left(u.content, 180) as replyContent, date_format(u.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') as replyTime, case when u.attachments is null or trim(u.attachments) in ('', 'null', '[]') then 0 else 1 end as replyFiles, coalesce(seen.update_id, 0) as seenId from jiedan_order o join jiedan_bug b on b.order_id = o.id left join jiedan_issue_review r on b.status = 'confirm' and r.bug_id = b.id and r.customer_id = #{customerId} and r.state = 'pending' left join jiedan_bug_update invite on invite.id = r.update_id left join jiedan_bug_update u on u.id = ( select max(m.update_id) from jiedan_bug_reply_meta m left join jiedan_issue_review notice on notice.update_id = m.update_id where m.bug_id = b.id and m.sender_kind = 'team' and (notice.update_id is null or (notice.customer_id = #{customerId} and notice.state != 'cancelled')) ) left join jiedan_customer_issue_seen seen on seen.bug_id = b.id and seen.customer_id = #{customerId} where o.customer_account = #{account} and o.del_flag = 0 order by b.id desc
select from jiedan_bug where id = #{id} for update
mapper.insert: insert into jiedan_bug (order_id, content, attachments, status, created_by, create_time) values (#{orderId}, #{content}, #{attachments}, #{status}, #{createdBy}, #{createTime})
mapper.update: update jiedan_bug set status = #{status} where id = #{id}
update jiedan_bug set attachments = #{attachments} where id = #{id}
